missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Море' is the neuter nominative subject. 'Спокойное' is the agreeing neuter adjective, and 'очень' intensifies it.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Море' is the accusative direct object of 'люблю'; the neuter form matches the nominative. A clean object example.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Моря' is genitive after 'от' to express distance from the sea. 'Недалеко' adds the nearness.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Морю' is the dative form after 'к' to show movement toward the sea. 'Утром' gives the time.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Море' is the prepositional form after 'в' to mark location; the neuter ending stays -е. 'Плавать' is the infinitive.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Море' is the accusative after 'за' to express movement beyond the sea. 'Корабль' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Морем' is instrumental after 'над' to mean above the sea. 'Чайки' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Моря' is genitive showing the water belongs to the sea. 'Вода' is the nominative subject, and 'летом' is instrumental of time.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Моря' is the nominative plural with end stress. 'Тёплые' agrees in the plural, and 'в России' is prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Моря' is genitive after 'у' to mean by the sea. 'Дети' is the nominative plural subject.
